news.title_zh: Costco 股票：盈利增長可能決定下一波大行情

news.summary: Clark Howard spent years watching couples bleed money one warehouse trip at a time, and the fix he landed on sounds almost too simple to work. With Costco shares surging past $1,000 and the holiday treasure-hunt season starting, the math behind his rule gets uncomfortable fast.
news.title: ‘Only Go Into Physical Stores Every Sixth Week’: Clark Howard’s Anti-Impulse Rule as Costco Hits $1,025
news.title_zh: 「每六週才進實體店一次」：克拉克·霍華德的反衝動購物規則，正值 Costco 股價衝上 $1,025
news.summary_zh: 克拉克·霍華德花了多年觀察情侶們一次倉儲式購物就大出血，他找到的對策聽起來簡單得幾乎不像會奏效。隨著 Costco 股價衝過 $1,000，假日尋寶季啟動，他規則背後的數學算起來讓人很不舒服。

news.summary: A lawyer-turned-retailer got fired from the discount chain he built over two decades, and the warehouse he opened next with a handful of friends and a converted Hughes property became the blueprint for one of the most powerful retail businesses on the planet.
news.title: In 1975, Sol Price Was Pushed Out of FedMart, the Discount Chain He Founded. The Warehouse Store He Opened Next Became Part of Costco
news.title_zh: 在 1975 年，Sol Price 被踢出他創辦的折扣連鎖 FedMart。他接著開設的倉儲店後來成為 Costco 的一部分
news.summary_zh: 這位從律師轉行的零售商，從他經營了二十多年的折扣連鎖店被解僱，隨後他和幾位朋友利用一處改建的 Hughes 房產開設的倉儲店，成了全球最強大零售企業之一的藍圖。

news.summary: Charlie Munger once said Costco is the one stock where you can look past the P/E. After a month-long rally, that exception faces its toughest test yet, and the business and the price may tell two different stories.
news.title: Jim Cramer Says Costco Is Still a Great Value. Charlie Munger’s Rule Explains Why
news.title_zh: 吉姆·克拉默稱 Costco 仍是超值股。查理·芒格的法則解釋原因
news.summary_zh: 查理·芒格曾說 Costco 是那檔可以不看本益比的股票。經過一個月的漲勢後，這個例外面臨迄今最嚴峻的考驗，基本面與股價可能講述兩個截然不同的故事。

news.title: Mosaic Raises Funds for Robotic Surgery
news.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. That’s likely for several reasons, including that Anthropic likely wants its stock to have some wiggle room to trade up after its IPO.) Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. One such startup, Mosaic Intelligence Labs , has raised $47 million across two rounds of seed fu

items.title: Mosaic Raises Funds for Robotic Surgery
items.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. That’s likely for several reasons, including that Anthropic likely wants its stock to have some wiggle room to trade up after its IPO.) Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. news.title: Alphabet, Meta, and Oracle Are All Teaming Up to Disrupt Nvidia's Biggest Competitive Advantage
news.summary: The biggest factor locking customers into Nvidia chips -- the dominance of its proprietary CUDA software platform -- is under threat.
news.title_zh: Alphabet、Meta 和 Oracle 皆聯手打擊輝達最大競爭優勢
news.summary_zh: 將客戶鎖定在輝達晶片的最大因素——其專有 CUDA 軟體平台的主導地位——正面臨威脅。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysCombined buybacks at Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle fell to $4. 4 billion in the third quarter, 90% below their late-2021 peak, according to a tally by The Kobeissi Letter.
news.title: Alphabet, Amazon and Meta Haven’t Bought Back a Share in 2026. Big Tech Buybacks Fell 90%
news.title_zh: Alphabet、亞馬遜和 Meta 在 2026 皆未回購一股。大型科技股回購下降 90%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet、亞馬遜、微軟、Meta 和 Oracle 的合併回購額降至 $4。4 billion 在第三季，較其晚期-2021 高點低 90%，據 The Kobeissi Letter 統計。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a deal to rent AI computing power from Oracle, days after Oracle canceled an estimated $7 billion chip-leasing deal with Tencent. The Microsoft contract itself looks small, but losing it leaves Oracle’s backlog leaning even harder on OpenAI, which S&P says accounts for about half of it.
news.title: The Stock Market Is “Petrified of Oracle’s Balance Sheet” as Microsoft Walks Away
news.title_zh: 股市「懼怕甲骨文資產負債表」 微軟撤資
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟正結束向甲骨文租用 AI 算力的協議，此前幾天甲骨文取消了估計 $7 billion 晶片租賃協議。微軟合約本身規模不大，但失去它使甲骨文的積壓訂單更加依賴 OpenAI，標普表示佔其約一半。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft wants fewer neocloud partners and won’t renew one of its cloud contracts with Oracle, CNBC reported on Friday. Citi’s Steven Wieting says Microsoft’s cost of debt is about 10 percentage points below CoreWeave’s.
news.title: Microsoft Borrows at “10 Percentage Points Below CoreWeave.” Now It’s Backing Away From Neoclouds
news.title_zh: 微軟以「10 Percentage Points 低於 CoreWeave」借款。如今它正遠離新雲端
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：據 CNBC 週五報導，微軟想要較少的新雲端合作夥伴，且不會續約其一項與 Oracle 的雲端合約。花旗的 Steven Wieting 表示，微軟的債務成本約為 10 percentage points 低於 CoreWeave。

news.summary: Originally announced in 2023, the partnership provided Microsoft with access to Oracle servers to operate an AI-supported edition of its Bing search engine.
news.title: Microsoft reportedly winds down Oracle AI infrastructure contract
